service.name: Emotional Wellness & Stress Reset Program

hero.intro: A 75-minute reset inside the workday. Sound healing, guided breathwork and meditation help people settle their nervous system and leave with a breathing tool they can use at their desk.

image.alt: A team resting on mats during an in-office stress reset session

shift.heading: For teams carrying pressure, fatigue, and mental noise.
shift.body:
This session creates a calm reset inside the workday. The format blends sound healing, guided breathwork and
          meditation so people can settle their nervous system and leave with repeatable tools.

items: Guided sound healing with Tibetan bowls

rhythm.heading: Quiet structure, not a rushed workshop.
rhythm.body:
The experience is paced like a nervous-system reset: soft arrival, guided release, and a grounded close that
          turns the session into something people can carry back to work.

steps.title: Settle
steps.description: Breathwork and body awareness bring the team out of work-mode and into a calmer shared room.

steps.title: Release
steps.description: Tibetan bowls, guided meditation and emotional mapping help clear built-up stress without forcing discussion.

steps.title: Integrate
steps.description: Simple take-home practices make the reset practical for desks, meetings and high-pressure days.

whoFor.heading: Built for teams running on empty.
items: Teams post-crunch, after launches, quarter-close or long delivery pushes

Leaders who want a reset that needs zero prep from their people

outcomes.label: A repeatable tool for desk stress

prep.heading: Simple to host. We handle the rest.
prep.intro: Here's exactly what your team needs to prepare — and what we bring.

cards.title: Your team provides
items: A quiet room or hall, lights dimmable
Floor space for mats/cushions (we bring bowls)
90 min clear on the calendar (75-min session + settle-in)
Phones on silent, no hard stops mid-session

cards.title: Good to know
items: Come as you are — no experience needed
Optional: a light space, not right after a heavy lunch
We arrive 45 min early to set the room

pricing.heading: How engagements are priced.
pricing.intro: Every quote is fixed in writing before you commit, and depends on team size, location and format. GST invoice provided.

cards.description: A one-off reset for your team.
Recurring slots that build a habit.

pricing.note: Prices exclude GST and travel for offsite formats. Free rescheduling with 72 hours' notice.

items.question: How large a team can join one session?
items.answer: 10–80 people works well. Above 80 we split into two sittings or add a co-facilitator so the sound still reaches everyone.

items.question: Our team is sceptical about sound healing. Will this feel awkward?
items.answer: We keep it grounded — no chanting or forced sharing. It's guided breath, Tibetan bowls and rest. Sceptics usually leave the calmest.

items.question: On-site or at a studio?
items.answer: Both. We travel across Gurgaon and Delhi-NCR to your office, or host at a partner studio. On-site is most popular for full teams.

items.question: Is it tied to any religion?
items.answer: No. It's a secular, nervous-system reset. Nothing devotional, nothing you need to believe in.

items.question: How much space and setup do you need?
items.answer: A room where people can sit or lie down. We bring bowls, mats and audio. You provide the room and 45 min of setup access.

items.question: Can remote or hybrid teams do this?
items.answer: Yes — we run a guided online version for distributed teams, though on-site lands deeper.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Quoted to your team size, location and format. Book a call for a fixed number.

items.question: How do we book and what's the notice?
items.answer: Message on WhatsApp or send the form. We usually need 5–7 days' notice; rush dates possible.
